open_points.subject: runtime_settings dependency on the environment table
open_points.question: How may `runtime_settings` access `config.runtime_environment_variables`, whose rows and values it must load and validate, when `models` is the only module it may know?
options: Add the module that provides `config.runtime_environment_variables` to `Knows`
Inject the table into `runtime_settings` without a module dependency
Generate the table into `runtime_settings` as module-owned data
open_points.default_guess: Add the provider of `config.runtime_environment_variables` to `Knows` and make the dependency point from `runtime_settings` to that provider.

open_points.subject: ownership of environment defaults
open_points.text: A default for a value nobody chose
open_points.question: Does `runtime_settings` merely apply defaults already declared in `config.runtime_environment_variables`, or is all defaulting forbidden when the deployment supplied no value?
options: It applies declared table defaults but does not choose new defaults
It must not apply a default when the environment omits a value
It owns both choosing and applying per-environment defaults
open_points.default_guess: It applies defaults declared by the table but does not choose their values.

witness.initial: An optional environment row is absent and its table row declares a per-environment default.
events: The host operator starts the portal.
outcomes: runtime_settings applies the declared default, as “load, normalize, default” and “Hides … per-environment defaults” prescribe.
runtime_settings leaves the value absent or refuses it because “A default for a value nobody chose” is outside its ownership.
witness.observer: The host operator and any portal component reading the resulting RuntimeSettings
